persona: Mid-level oncology biostatistician at a CRO
resumeText:
Arjun Menon | Bengaluru | arjun.menon@example.com

SUMMARY
Biostatistician with 7 years in clinical trials and observational studies, mostly oncology.

EXPERIENCE
Biostatistician, Nilgiri Clinical Research, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Wrote statistical analysis plans and table shells for Phase II and III oncology trials.
- Ran sample size calculations for two Phase III protocols using nQuery.
- Performed Kaplan-Meier and Cox regression analyses for overall survival endpoints.
- Fitted MMRM models in SAS for repeated measures efficacy endpoints.
- Reviewed safety tables and listings produced by the programming team.
- Presented interim results to the sponsor study team and answered their questions.

Statistical Analyst, Malabar Health Analytics, Kochi (2019 - 2021)
- Used SAS procedures for descriptive statistics and hypothesis testing in observational studies.

SKILLS
SAS, Statistics, CDISC ADaM

EDUCATION
MSc Biostatistics, Manipal Academy of Higher Education, 2019
